summary: Allocates and initializes a file stream context object based on a mode string. Parses the mode characters ('r' sets read mode, 'w'/'a' set write mode, 'f' sets binary flag=1, 'h' sets flag=2), skips digit characters, and copies remaining characters into a scratch path buffer. Allocates a 16KB (0x4000) stream buffer, wires a memory-allocator object, resolves the underlying file handle either from an existing handle argument or by opening the path, writes the 'CCCC' header when opening for write, and validates the header when opening for read. On any allocation or open failure the partial context is freed through FileHandleDestructorWithModeCheck and 0 is returned.

local_names.v15: write pointer into scratch path buffer
